description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Chocobo Drift, Chocobo Style, Acrobatics 5 ranks

Benefit: When you strike a target with Chocobo Style, an explosion of fiery energy happens, dealing 5d6 points of fire damage to the target and all creatures within a 15-ft.-radius, a Reflex save for half damage. This is in addition to the damage the target takes from Chocobo Style and is not multiplied on a critical hit.

system.requirements: Improved Unarmed Strike, Chocobo Drift, Chocobo Style, Acrobatics 5 ranks
